title: Sleepy little dragon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <g>
    <!-- tail curling to the left -->
    <path d='M30 78 Q14 78 12 68 Q11 61 18 60 Q24 60 23 66' stroke='#4FC3F7' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M31 80 Q35 76 40 78' stroke='#4FC3F7' stroke-width='4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- body -->
    <ellipse cx='52' cy='76' rx='24' ry='15' fill='#66D17A'/>
    <ellipse cx='52' cy='80' rx='20' ry='10' fill='#8FE39C'/>
    <!-- little back spikes -->
    <path d='M36 66 L32 58 L41 62 Z' fill='#FFB84D'/>
    <path d='M46 62 L44 53 L53 59 Z' fill='#FFB84D'/>
    <path d='M57 61 L57 52 L65 59 Z' fill='#FFB84D'/>
    <!-- wing folded on back -->
    <path d='M62 66 Q78 60 82 72 Q74 78 62 74 Z' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
    <path d='M66 68 Q76 64 79 71 Q72 75 66 72 Z' fill='#A8E4FF'/>
    <!-- front legs -->
    <ellipse cx='42' cy='88' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#55BE6C'/>
    <ellipse cx='60' cy='88' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#55BE6C'/>
    <circle cx='42' cy='89' r='2' fill='#FFC9B0'/>
    <circle cx='60' cy='89' r='2' fill='#FFC9B0'/>
    <!-- head -->
    <ellipse cx='68' cy='56' rx='18' ry='15' fill='#7CDD8C'/>
    <!-- snout -->
    <ellipse cx='80' cy='61' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#A7EBB2'/>
    <!-- nostrils -->
    <circle cx='87' cy='59' r='1.6' fill='#2E9E4A'/>
    <circle cx='87' cy='63' r='1.6' fill='#2E9E4A'/>
    <!-- closed sleepy eyes -->
    <path d='M66 52 Q70 56 74 52' stroke='#2E9E4A' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <path d='M78 51 Q82 55 86 51' stroke='#2E9E4A' stroke-width='2.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <!-- blush -->
    <ellipse cx='64' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#FF9FB2'/>
    <ellipse cx='78' cy='66' rx='3.5' ry='2.2' fill='#FF9FB2'/>
    <!-- horns -->
    <path d='M62 42 Q63 31 70 34 Q67 39 68 43 Z' fill='#FFB84D'/>
    <path d='M73 42 Q77 32 83 36 Q78 39 78 44 Z' fill='#FFB84D'/>
    <!-- ear -->
    <path d='M56 46 Q49 40 54 35 Q58 40 61 45 Z' fill='#4FC3F7'/>
    <!-- little zzz -->
    <path d='M76 30 h6 l-6 6 h6' stroke='#D7B3FF' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
    <path d='M86 20 h5 l-5 5 h5' stroke='#D7B3FF' stroke-width='1.8' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'/>
  </g>
</svg>
